title: Google\Cloud\Container\V1\Gapic\ClusterManagerGapicClient
name: ClusterManagerGapicClient
description: Service Description: Google Kubernetes Engine Cluster Manager v1.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor.

methods.name: listClusters
methods.description: Lists all clusters owned by a project in either the specified zone or all zones.

methods.name: getCluster
methods.description: Gets the details of a specific cluster.

methods.name: createCluster
methods.description: Creates a cluster, consisting of the specified number and type of Google Compute Engine instances.

params.name: cluster
params.description: Required. A cluster resource

methods.name: updateCluster
methods.description: Updates the settings of a specific cluster.

params.name: update
params.description: Required. A description of the update.

methods.name: updateNodePool
methods.description: Updates the version and/or image type for the specified node pool.

params.name: nodeVersion
params.description:
Required. The Kubernetes version to change the nodes to (typically an upgrade).

Users may specify either explicit versions offered by Kubernetes Engine or version aliases, which have the following behavior:

  • "latest": picks the highest valid Kubernetes version
  • "1.X": picks the highest valid patch+gke.N patch in the 1.X version
  • "1.X.Y": picks the highest valid gke.N patch in the 1.X.Y version
  • "1.X.Y-gke.N": picks an explicit Kubernetes version
  • "-": picks the Kubernetes master version

params.name: imageType
params.description: Required. The desired image type for the node pool.

methods.name: setNodePoolAutoscaling
methods.description: Sets the autoscaling settings for the specified node pool.

params.name: autoscaling
params.description: Required. Autoscaling configuration for the node pool.

methods.name: setLoggingService
methods.description: Sets the logging service for a specific cluster.

params.name: loggingService
params.description:
Required. The logging service the cluster should use to write logs. Currently available options:

  • logging.googleapis.com/kubernetes - The Cloud Logging service with a Kubernetes-native resource model
  • logging.googleapis.com - The legacy Cloud Logging service (no longer available as of GKE 1.15).
  • none - no logs will be exported from the cluster.

If left as an empty string,logging.googleapis.com/kubernetes will be used for GKE 1.14+ or logging.googleapis.com for earlier versions.

methods.name: setMonitoringService
methods.description: Sets the monitoring service for a specific cluster.

params.name: monitoringService
params.description:
Required. The monitoring service the cluster should use to write metrics. Currently available options:

  • "monitoring.googleapis.com/kubernetes" - The Cloud Monitoring service with a Kubernetes-native resource model
  • monitoring.googleapis.com - The legacy Cloud Monitoring service (no longer available as of GKE 1.15).
  • none - No metrics will be exported from the cluster.

If left as an empty string,monitoring.googleapis.com/kubernetes will be used for GKE 1.14+ or monitoring.googleapis.com for earlier versions.

methods.name: setAddonsConfig
methods.description: Sets the addons for a specific cluster.

params.name: addonsConfig
params.description: Required. The desired configurations for the various addons available to run in the cluster.

methods.name: setLocations
methods.description: Sets the locations for a specific cluster.

params.name: locations
params.description:
Required. The desired list of Google Compute Engine zones in which the cluster's nodes should be located. Changing the locations a cluster is in will result in nodes being either created or removed from the cluster, depending on whether locations are being added or removed.

This list must always include the cluster's primary zone.

methods.name: updateMaster
methods.description: Updates the master for a specific cluster.

params.name: masterVersion
params.description:
Required. The Kubernetes version to change the master to.

Users may specify either explicit versions offered by Kubernetes Engine or version aliases, which have the following behavior:

  • "latest": picks the highest valid Kubernetes version
  • "1.X": picks the highest valid patch+gke.N patch in the 1.X version
  • "1.X.Y": picks the highest valid gke.N patch in the 1.X.Y version
  • "1.X.Y-gke.N": picks an explicit Kubernetes version
  • "-": picks the default Kubernetes version

methods.name: setMasterAuth
methods.description: Sets master auth materials. Currently supports changing the admin password or a specific cluster, either via password generation or explicitly setting the password.

params.name: action
params.description: Required. The exact form of action to be taken on the master auth. For allowed values, use constants defined on %1$s

params.name: update
params.description: Required. A description of the update.

methods.name: deleteCluster
methods.description: Deletes the cluster, including the Kubernetes endpoint and all worker nodes.

methods.name: listOperations
methods.description: Lists all operations in a project in a specific zone or all zones.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Gets the specified operation.

methods.name: cancelOperation
methods.description: Cancels the specified operation.

methods.name: getServerConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration info about the Google Kubernetes Engine service.

methods.name: getJSONWebKeys
methods.description: Gets the public component of the cluster signing keys in JSON Web Key format.

methods.name: listNodePools
methods.description: Lists the node pools for a cluster.

methods.name: getNodePool
methods.description: Retrieves the requested node pool.

methods.name: createNodePool
methods.description: Creates a node pool for a cluster.

params.name: nodePool
params.description: Required. The node pool to create.

methods.name: deleteNodePool
methods.description: Deletes a node pool from a cluster.

methods.name: rollbackNodePoolUpgrade
methods.description: Rolls back a previously Aborted or Failed NodePool upgrade.

methods.name: setNodePoolManagement
methods.description: Sets the NodeManagement options for a node pool.

params.name: management
params.description: Required. NodeManagement configuration for the node pool.

methods.name: setLabels
methods.description: Sets labels on a cluster.

params.name: resourceLabels
params.description: Required. The labels to set for that cluster.

params.name: labelFingerprint
params.description: Required. The fingerprint of the previous set of labels for this resource, used to detect conflicts. The fingerprint is initially generated by Kubernetes Engine and changes after every request to modify or update labels. You must always provide an up-to-date fingerprint hash when updating or changing labels. Make a get() request to the resource to get the latest fingerprint.

methods.name: setLegacyAbac
methods.description: Enables or disables the ABAC authorization mechanism on a cluster.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Required. Whether ABAC authorization will be enabled in the cluster.

methods.name: startIPRotation
methods.description: Starts master IP rotation.

methods.name: completeIPRotation
methods.description: Completes master IP rotation.

methods.name: setNodePoolSize
methods.description: Sets the size for a specific node pool.

params.name: nodeCount
params.description: Required. The desired node count for the pool.

methods.name: setNetworkPolicy
methods.description: Enables or disables Network Policy for a cluster.

params.name: networkPolicy
params.description: Required. Configuration options for the NetworkPolicy feature.

methods.name: setMaintenancePolicy
methods.description: Sets the maintenance policy for a cluster.

params.name: projectId
params.description: Required. The Google Developers Console project ID or project number.

params.name: zone
params.description: Required. The name of the Google Compute Engine zone in which the cluster resides.

params.name: clusterId
params.description: Required. The name of the cluster to update.

params.name: maintenancePolicy
params.description: Required. The maintenance policy to be set for the cluster. An empty field clears the existing maintenance policy.

methods.name: listUsableSubnetworks
methods.description: Lists subnetworks that are usable for creating clusters in a project.
